title: Cacti Liquid Plant Food
description:
Dosage

1 pump (~2mL) for 1L of water.  (The cap is 4.5mm!)

How to Use

1. Fill your watering can.
2. (Optional) Let water sit for 24 hours to reach room temperature and allow chlorine to evaporate.
3. Shake well and add fertiliser to the watering can.
4. Water plants as normal.

Tips

  • Fertilize every time you water to maintain stable soil chemistry.
  • Forget to fertilize? No problem! Just resume next time.
  • Use half the dosage in fall/winter or when plants stop growing.
  • Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
  • Use within 48 hours after mixing with water.
  • Do not use this fertiliser the first 180 days after repotting with SYBASoil!

*We do not recommend using this as a foliage spray, as residue will build up on the leaves.

Cacti BIO Liquid Plant Food

Cacti BIO Liquid Plant Food provides clean, fast-acting nutrition tailored to the unique needs of cacti, succulents and ferns. This cactus bio fertilizer mixes easily with water, delivering gentle nutrients that are quickly absorbed by the roots. Designed for use during the active growth season, this cactus liquid fertilizer strengthens spines, supports root health, and promotes compact, but resilient growth.

Why Liquid Feeding Works for Cacti

Cacti have lower nutrient requirements than leafy houseplants, but they still need support during growth. Traditional fertilizers often contain too much nitrogen, which can cause weak or elongated growth. This cactus nutrient solution avoids that problem with a balanced, low-nitrogen, potassium-rich blend that enhances structure and resilience. As an organic cactus food, it nourishes without overwhelming, helping your plants maintain their natural form.

Easy to Use, Effective Every Time

This cactus growth liquid fits seamlessly into your watering routine. Simply dilute the formula and when watering during the growing season. The quick-absorbing nature ensures cactus organic nutrients reach the roots immediately, without buildup or residue. With consistent use, this cactus plant booster reduces the risk of nutrient deficiencies and keeps your plants looking strong, compact, and stress-free.

Benefits of Bio Liquid Feeding

  • Fast absorption for visible improvements in growth and resilience
  • Balanced formula designed for desert plants with slower metabolisms
  • Provides cactus natural fertilizer without harsh chemicals
  • Helps prevent weak or leggy growth by limiting nitrogen
  • Safe for regular use in soil-based cactus setups
  • Super-concentrated, fertilises 250L of water
  • 100% Bio & Vegan, good for the planet & your plant

With cactus bio feeding, your plants receive steady care that matches their unique needs, without the risk of overfeeding.

Clean and Sustainable by Design

Sybotanica develops every SYBASupport formula with a focus on sustainability and effectiveness. This cactus care fertilizer is made with plant-safe, organic ingredients and supports healthier growth without compromising the environment. Trusted by cactus lovers across Europe, it offers a simple and reliable way to keep your collection thriving with long-lasting results.

With Sybotanica, Cacti BIO Liquid Plant Food helps your desert plants stay compact, resilient, and naturally beautiful season after season.
